title: Dashboard command reply: server to dashboard (contract v0.2, draft)
description: The immediate answer to a dashboard command. 'queued' only means the server accepted it for the bot; whether the bot applied it shows up later in the overview's recent_commands.

status.description: duplicate = the same client_request_id was already accepted; command_id is the original one.

expires_at.description: If the bot has not picked the command up by then it expires and nothing happens (about 2 minutes).

reason.description: Plain-language reason when rejected, for example 'Lot 0.50 is above the max lot of 0.10'.
